YSRCP to make 'MAVIGUN' its 2029 election plank

Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister Jagan Reddy announced that the YSRCP will use 'MAVIGUN' as its central election plank for the 2029 polls. He stated that this proposal will be presented as an alternative development model. Reddy also claimed that the Amaravati project has become a conduit for corruption.
